stories.title: EN DIRECT - Présidentielle 2027 : revivez les moments forts du premier débat des candidats à la primaire à gauche

en.title: LIVE - 2027 Presidential Election: relive the highlights of the first debate among left-wing primary candidates
en.summary: The start of the left-wing primary was marked by the surprise exclusion of Socialist deputy Philippe Brun, who had secured endorsements, due to accusations of violence against a former collaborator.

stories.title: «Mais Pangram va te faire foutre» : Virginie Despentes attaque la plateforme qui accuse Thélyson Orélien

en.title: "But Pangram is going to screw you": Virginie Despentes attacks the platform accusing Thélyson Orélien
en.summary: Successful author Virginie Despentes criticized an AI detection platform during a television appearance, arguing it was poorly positioned to judge whether writers used artificial intelligence given the technology's widespread presence.

stories.title: À son procès pour corruption, Rachida Dati a réponse à tout

en.title: At her corruption trial, Rachida Dati has an answer for everything
en.summary: Former minister Rachida Dati faced intense questioning from the court, prosecutor, and civil parties at her corruption trial, maintaining her position but struggling to convince on substantive matters.

stories.title: Polémique Thélyson Orélien : comment fonctionne le détecteur de textes générés par IA, Pangram, et à quel point est-il fiable ?

en.title: Thélyson Orélien controversy: how does the AI-generated text detector Pangram work, and how reliable is it?
en.summary: American startup Pangram, which claims to identify artificially generated texts with high confidence, is central to the controversy involving author Thélyson Orélien and his novel "C'était ça ou mourir".

stories.title: Présidentielle 2027 : revivez le premier débat entre les cinq candidats de la primaire à gauche

en.title: 2027 Presidential election: relive the first debate between the five candidates of the left primary
en.summary: Five left-wing primary candidates—Raphaël Glucksmann, Ségolène Royal, Olivier Faure, Jérôme Guedj, and Emmanuel Maurel—debated Wednesday evening on TF1-LCI before a panel of French citizens.

stories.title: "L'intention d'homicide est évidente" : au procès de l'assassinat de Federico Martin Aramburu, vingt-sept ans de prison sont requis contre Loïk Le Priol

en.title: "Intention to murder is evident": at the trial of Federico Martin Aramburu's assassination, twenty-seven years in prison are sought against Loïk Le Priol
en.summary: Prosecutors are seeking a 27-year prison sentence for Loïk Le Priol and 20 years for Romain Bouvier in connection with an assassination case, with a verdict expected Friday.

stories.title: EN DIRECT, guerre en Ukraine : « Nous savons que la Russie recrute des ressortissants de 47 pays pour mener cette guerre », dénonce Volodymyr Zelensky à l’ONU

en.title: LIVE, war in Ukraine: "We know that Russia is recruiting nationals from 47 countries to conduct this war", denounces Volodymyr Zelensky at the UN
en.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky addressed the UN General Assembly, stating that Russia is recruiting citizens from 47 countries for its war in Ukraine, hours after Russian Foreign Minister Sergueï Lavrov declared Russia will not pursue a truce.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein est condamné à quinze ans de prison pour une agression sexuelle commise en 2006

en.title: Harvey Weinstein is sentenced to fifteen years in prison for a sexual assault committed in 2006
en.summary: Harvey Weinstein, founder of Miramax studios whose sexual crimes sparked the #MeToo movement, received a 15-year prison sentence for a 2006 sexual assault, in addition to a prior 16-year conviction.

stories.title: Au procès de l’assassinat de Federico Aramburu, vingt-sept ans de prison requis contre Loïk Le Priol et vingt ans contre Romain Bouvier

en.title: In the trial of Federico Aramburu's murder, twenty-seven years in prison requested against Loïk Le Priol and twenty years against Romain Bouvier
en.summary: Two men are being tried in Paris for the 2022 death of former rugby player Federico Aramburu, who was shot twice in the back. Prosecutors have requested 27 years in prison for one defendant and 20 years for the other, with a verdict expected Friday.

stories.title: L'ancien producteur de cinéma Harvey Weinstein condamné à 15 ans de prison pour une agression sexuelle datant de 2006

en.title: Former film producer Harvey Weinstein sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault dating from 2006
en.summary: A New York court has convicted former Hollywood producer Harvey Weinstein of sexual assault against a former production assistant. He has been sentenced to 15 years in prison.

stories.title: Harvey Weinstein de nouveau condamné à 15 ans de prison pour l’agression sexuelle d’une assistante de production

en.title: Harvey Weinstein again sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault of a production assistant
en.summary: The 74-year-old former Hollywood producer Harvey Weinstein has received another 15-year prison sentence in New York for sexually assaulting a production assistant. This follows years of legal proceedings in the case.

stories.title: 🔴 Harvey Weinstein de nouveau condamné à 15 ans de prison pour une agression sexuelle en 2006

en.title: Harvey Weinstein again sentenced to 15 years in prison for sexual assault in 2006
en.summary: Harvey Weinstein has been sentenced to 15 years in prison for a 2006 sexual assault.

stories.title: Parc éolien d’Aumelas : EDF Power Solutions obtient sa relaxe

en.title: Aumelas wind farm: EDF Power Solutions obtains acquittal
en.summary: An appeals court in Montpellier overturned a conviction against EDF Power Solutions related to the Aumelas wind farm project. An environmental organization plans to appeal the decision.

stories.title: Deux astronautes sur la Lune pour l’Italie, à plus de deux milliards et demi de dollars le siège

en.title: Two astronauts on the Moon for Italy, at more than two and a half billion dollars per seat
en.summary: NASA's chief confirmed Italy will send two astronauts to the lunar surface in exchange for investing over 5 billion dollars in lunar infrastructure. NASA also addressed the ESA's Argonaut program.

stories.title: Après la crise, le renouveau du site industriel d’Arkema à Jarrie, en Isère

en.title: After the crisis, renewal of Arkema's industrial site in Jarrie, Isère
en.summary: French chemical company Arkema inaugurated a hydrogen production unit in Isère nearly two years after announcing 154 job cuts at the same facility, investing ten million euros to secure hydrogen peroxide production.

stories.title: L’US Space Force en appelle aux commerciaux pour renforcer sa surveillance du trafic spatial

en.title: The US Space Force appeals to commercial providers to strengthen its space traffic surveillance
en.summary: The US Space Force signed multiple contracts with Northrop Grumman, Impulse Space, and True Anomaly to procure satellites for monitoring space traffic at reduced cost.

stories.title: Exolaunch et Space Cargo Unlimited, premiers clients de la capsule Starfall qui volera avec Starship

en.title: Exolaunch and Space Cargo Unlimited, first customers for SpaceX's Starfall capsule to fly with Starship
en.summary: Exolaunch and Space Cargo Unlimited have reserved flights on SpaceX's Starfall capsule, which will launch aboard Starship beginning in 2029.
